title: Post the real ones / urban billboard

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Keep an outdoor message short enough to read amid competing street information.
strategic_value: A gradient frame and simple phrase can help Instagram retain identity around a candid photograph.
demonstration: A long billboard above a storefront places a photograph between Post the and real ones, with a small white glyph.
practical_value: Compare the headline and central image at the viewing distance implied by the streetscape.

content_islands.name: Billboard composition
content_islands.spec: Place the photograph centrally with short white text on the gradient at either side.

content_islands.name: Urban context
content_islands.spec: Retain storefronts, traffic and neighboring buildings to show the competition for attention.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows the campaign in a busy urban placement.
reference_purposes.Expression: The gradient and concise split headline frame a candid human scene.
